title: EMVCo reqests feedback on framework for card-based agentic payments
summary: EMVCo – the technical body that creates and manages EMV®  Specifications and programmes – has released a draft framework to help promote secure, interoperable and scalable card-based agentic payments.
content: EMVCo, the technical body responsible for managing EMV specifications and programmes, has released a new draft framework. The initiative is designed to promote secure, interoperable, and scalable card-based agentic payments. The organization is currently seeking industry feedback on the proposed framework to help shape the future of these automated payment systems.
